final.T_equiv_note: Energy-matched mixture of local bound canonical distributions, weighted by surviving spatial populations; proxy only. None means no finite positive-temperature match.
final.energy_observable_note: Actual local excitation energies per survivor, including loss selection; n_z=0 is not the 3D ground state.

magnetic_validity.breit_rabi_source: analytic Breit-Rabi using cached ARC hyperfine splitting and g factors
notes: Ground, D1, and D2 hyperfine + Zeeman eigenstates and mixed optical dipoles; F,m labels follow the B=0 branches adiabatically. Fine-structure mixing and diamagnetism omitted.

validity.message: Ground, D1, and D2 hyperfine + Zeeman eigenstates and mixed optical dipoles; F,m labels follow the B=0 branches adiabatically. Fine-structure mixing and diamagnetism omitted.
adjacent-mF Zeeman angular splitting / maximum photon rate across nodes = 313 (needs >>1)
maximum eliminated excited fraction across nodes and spin states = 0.0002458
max optical rate / smallest local motional angular spacing across all axes = 0.11
Modeled spatial/thermal decay; RMS carrier frequency = 5000 Hz fixes initial curvature. No fitted homogeneous damping; reported decay is not a calibration constraint or an experimental validation.
Joint spin/nx/ny/nz populations and a shared 3D emission direction retained. Interference between emitted spherical dipole channels remains neglected.
Population-resolving scattering erases motional coherence and treats elastic spin amplitudes as distinguishable; this is an additional approximation beyond secular averaging.

Separable isolated wells with Gaussian local depths; no tunnelling, coherent Raman continuum excitation, envelope transport or recapture. Scalar trap basis with diagonal differential shifts; trap shape changes from spin-dependent shifts neglected.

Raman/trap Stark operators use diagonal matrix elements; static off-diagonal motional dressing and trap-basis changes are omitted. Excited-state lattice shifts of the pumping transitions remain the configured common optical shift.
1 frozen Gaussian position / uniform registration samples. Refine samples and time_step_us for convergence; samples are numerical quadrature, not experimental error bars.
Axis temperatures are energy-matched bound-state mixture proxies; survivor cooling of undriven axes may result from preferential loss.

calibration.note: Modeled spatial/thermal carrier decay; intensity fixes RMS local carrier frequency to the supplied measured frequency (initial-curvature convention). No fitted homogeneous damping. The reported envelope is a comparison only, not a calibration constraint. The inhomogeneous 1/e time is a first crossing, not an exponential fit. Visibility does not remove atoms.

cooling_rate_method: Savitzky-Golay derivative of survivor mean local z energy / level index
assumptions: Initially loaded Gaussian cloud, conditional on local bound states; axial preparation mode thermal_temperature, configured axial temperature 1e-05 K, transverse temperature 1e-05 K. Loading survival unspecified.

Emission uses one shared 3D photon direction across lattice axes; spherical dipole channels remain resolved and recoil coherence transfer is omitted.
ARC D1+D2 scattering includes fine/hyperfine interference and coherent same-tone beam absorption.

Fixed beat shared by all spatial samples; Gaussian local depths and pump/Raman intensities.
Loss on leaving any local bound manifold; no recapture. Temperature is a survivor-conditioned proxy.
